items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: he was with Sam Morgan Band and I... Sam Morgan, Gaillet, playing trombone, Alfred William drums.

ctx.x: Yeah, we've already got it. It's the third, this is the third reel of July the, what is it, the 10th? 10th. 1961, yeah. Okay. We're talking about Black Benny, how you used to hear him in the street?

Yes. Yeah, he was with Sam Morgan Band and I, I couldn't tell you too much, about too many of the fellas in the band. I could call three guys I know of sure, four I'd say. Sam Morgan, Gaillet, playing trombone, Alfred William drums. And if I'm not mistaken, I think Paul Vaughn was playing clarinet with him. I'm not too chill on that. It's been so long, you know. I really believe that he was playing, I just admire Black Benny's bass drum playing.
What sort of raps would he make on the bass drum?
